title: Clean Cad Play Terminology
description: Remove legacy spatial/R3F package naming from CAD play and related surfaces. Rename user-facing labels and identifiers to follow cad/js folder naming (CAD play, cad-play, CadPlay*, CAD_PLAY_*). Update imports/exports and launch configs. Run tests.
summary: Renamed legacy spatial/R3F play naming to CAD-aligned identifiers: SpatialPlay* → CadPlay*, SPATIAL_PLAY_* → CAD_PLAY_*, spatial-play/cad.play string ids, HTML title "CAD Play", modelsFromSpatialJson → modelsFromCadJson, __spatialR3fTestKernel → __cadRendererTestKernel. Updated package description and renderer docstring path. All 45 @semio-tech/cad-js-renderer tests pass.
